name: cortex-ai-ide
description: Node.js runtime assets for Cortex AI IDE. The editor pane loads Monaco Editor from node_modules/monaco-editor, so this manifest must be installed before running the app from source.

comments.monaco-editor: Pinned to 0.52.x on purpose. Cortex injects node_modules/monaco-editor/min/vs/loader.js (the AMD loader) into editor.html. Newer major lines may drop the AMD build, so keep this on 0.52 until the editor is migrated to the ESM bundle.
